title: P14 kill test attempt 1 sent SIGTERM to an already-exited driver and still printed a post-kill state
what_went_wrong: The driver ended early (builder failure); the kill test's wait loop broke on driver exit and then sent SIGTERM to a dead process group (kill: No such process) and printed a clean state that was not produced by a kill.
root_cause: The kill test did not check that the kill point (oracle running, harness alive) was reached.
impact: None claimed from attempt 1; it is kept as evidence of the driver's failure-path cleanup only.

correction.applied: Kill test now exits 1 with KILL-TEST-NOT-EXERCISED if the driver is gone before the kill point, and waits for a live BilingHarness before killing.
correction.result: Attempt 2: harness alive 3 at kill, clean post-kill state (evidence/p14/t2_kill_test.txt).

rule: A fault-injection test must prove the fault landed (target alive at injection) before judging recovery.
